faqs.question: What are your store hours?
faqs.answer: We're open Monday to Saturday, 10 AM to 8 PM. We're closed on Sundays and public holidays.

faqs.question: Do you offer refunds?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer a full refund within 7 days of purchase if the product is unused and in original packaging.

faqs.question: How long does shipping take?
faqs.answer: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days. Express shipping (extra charge) takes 1-2 business days.

faqs.question: Do you ship internationally?
faqs.answer: Currently we only ship within India. International shipping is coming soon.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept UPI, credit/debit cards, net banking, and cash on delivery (COD) for orders under Rs. 5000.

faqs.question: How can I track my order?
faqs.answer: Once your order ships, you'll receive a tracking link via SMS and email. You can also check order status by logging into your account.

faqs.question: Can I cancel my order?
faqs.answer: Orders can be cancelled within 2 hours of placing them. After that, the order enters processing and cannot be cancelled.

faqs.question: Do you have a physical store?
faqs.answer: We are currently an online-only store, but we're planning to open physical locations soon.

faqs.question: How do I contact customer support?
faqs.answer: You can reach us at support@demostore.com or call us at +91-9999999999, Monday to Saturday, 10 AM to 6 PM.

faqs.question: Is my payment information secure?
faqs.answer: Yes, all payments are processed through encrypted, PCI-compliant payment gateways. We never store your card details.
